qs.lead: The decisions that weigh the most —where to live, where to invest, where to settle— are too often made blindly. And many go wrong not through bad luck, but through lack of information.
qs.s1.title: Born in the field, not behind a desk
qs.s1.p1: Behind ROMVILL lie years of real experience in security management, risk analysis and intelligence, in demanding, high-level environments, in Spain and internationally. A career that taught us one lesson that kept repeating itself.
qs.s1.p2: When you protect people and assess threats, you learn that the difference between getting it right and getting it wrong is almost never luck. It is information.
qs.quote: The greatest risk is not the one you see, but the one you do not know.
qs.s2.title: We are analysts, not salespeople
qs.s2.p1: We apply that same discipline to analysing the Mediterranean Coast —Alicante, Málaga and Marbella—: intelligence methodology, verified official sources (OSINT) and direct on-site verification. We are not a real-estate agency or a generic data search.
qs.s2.p2: We study an area with the same rigour used to assess an environment before a critical decision: no shortcuts, no hidden interests, with both feet on the ground.
qs.values.title: What we believe in
qs.v1.d: We do not sell property or earn commissions. Our only interest is that you have the truth.
qs.v2.d: We cross-check official sources with on-site checks. Data, not rumours.
qs.v3.d: Absolute confidentiality. It is part of our craft.
qs.v4.d: We give you information to decide, not to impress.
qs.close1: No one should have to gamble on a life-changing decision for lack of information.
qs.close2: That is what we are here for: so you decide with judgement, not with hope.

faq.hero.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.hero.sub: Everything worth knowing about how we work, what you receive and why you can trust an independent analysis.
faq.noresult: We found no question matching those words. Try another term or write to us directly.

faq.cta.p: Tell us which area interests you and receive an independent analysis, with no commitment.
faq.q.que-comprobar: What should I check before buying a home on the Mediterranean Coast?
faq.a.que-comprobar: Beyond the property itself, it pays to look at the surroundings: safety and community, nearby services and healthcare, mobility and access, the population profile and which official works or projects are planned. That is exactly what we gather in an area analysis, using official sources and on-site verification, so you don't decide on a single visit alone.
faq.q.zona-que-no-conozco: How do I know if an area I don't know is right for me?
faq.a.zona-que-no-conozco: With structured, verifiable information, not with the impressions of one afternoon. We give you the real context of the area —what exists today and what is officially planned— so you can weigh it against what you need. Tell us which area interests you and we'll prepare it.
faq.q.para-que-sirve: Is the report useful for living, investing or holiday rentals?
faq.a.para-que-sirve: For all three. The same rigour applies whether you are looking for where to live, where to invest or assessing an area for rental; only the emphasis changes. We show you the real context —without promising returns— so you decide. See both profiles in Sectors.
faq.q.que-es: What exactly is a ROMVILL report?
faq.a.que-es: A territorial intelligence analysis of the area you care about: safety, demographics, healthcare, mobility, services and official urban planning. We gather and cross-check the information and deliver it as a structured, easy-to-read report, free of jargon. You can see all the dimensions we analyse here.
faq.q.vivienda-o-zona: Do you analyse a specific property or just the area?
faq.a.vivienda-o-zona: Our work is the surroundings: the area and everything around it. In the Premium level we also add the analysis of a specific property within that context. You can see what each level includes in Pricing.
faq.q.de-donde-datos: Where does the data come from?
faq.a.de-donde-datos: From official sources and public records —such as the Police and Guardia Civil or official urban planning—, which we cross-check against each other and confirm with on-site verification. We remove hearsay and guesswork: every figure is verifiable. We explain it in our methodology.
faq.q.que-recibo: What do I receive and in what format?
faq.a.que-recibo: A structured, clear, jargon-free dossier with everything relevant about the area, tailored to your needs and with every figure cited to its source. Depending on the level you choose, it also includes an interactive web version and, in Premium, the report in two languages and support from an analyst. See a real sample of the report here.
faq.a.cuanto-tarda: Depending on the level: Essential in 3-4 days, Superior in 5-7 days and Premium in 7-14 days. We confirm the timeframe when you order the report.
faq.a.independientes: Yes. We don't sell property or take commissions from agencies or developers, and we have no interests in the area. Our only job is to analyse; that's why what we tell you is not geared to selling you anything. Get to know us in About us.
faq.q.no-me-fio-inmobiliaria: Why not just rely on what the estate agency tells me?
faq.a.no-me-fio-inmobiliaria: The agency does its job: selling the property. We do a different, complementary one: analysing the surroundings with nothing to sell you. We don't replace the agency; we give you an independent second opinion on the area so you sign with the full picture, not only the seller's.
faq.q.buena-o-mala: Will you tell me whether an area is good or bad?
faq.a.buena-o-mala: No. We describe the real context with objective data from official sources, without rating the area by danger or passing judgement. We give you reliable, organised information; the decision is yours. Our role is to help you decide with sound judgement, not to decide for you.
faq.q.revalorizacion: Do you promise an area will increase in value?
faq.a.revalorizacion: No. We compile the projects and infrastructure set out in official public planning (works, facilities, urban development), but we make no forecasts of future property values or promises of future returns. We show you what is officially planned; interpreting its impact is your decision.
faq.a.confidencial: Absolute confidentiality. Your data is not shared with third parties and your enquiry stays between you and us. It is part of our craft.
faq.q.actualizacion-datos: How often do you update an area's data?
faq.a.actualizacion-datos: Each report is built with data current at the time you order it: we don't reuse old studies. For every commission we gather and cross-check the information from official sources again. That's how we work, step by step, in Methodology.
faq.q.diferencia-tasacion: How is this different from a valuation or what the seller tells me?
faq.a.diferencia-tasacion: A valuation puts a price on a property; the seller wants to close the sale. We do neither: we analyse the surroundings in an independent way, with nothing to sell you, using official sources. It is information distinct from and complementary to both. Get to know us in About us.
faq.q.zonas: Which areas do you work in?
faq.a.zonas: The Mediterranean Coast: Alicante, Málaga and Marbella and their surroundings. On an exceptional basis we produce reports for other cities or abroad under a custom quote.
faq.q.desde-extranjero: Can I order the report from abroad?
faq.a.desde-extranjero: Yes. The whole process is remote: you tell us which area interests you, we prepare the report and deliver it digitally. No need to travel. You can also deal with us in Spanish, English, French, German or Russian. Write to us and we reply within 24-48 hours (working days).
faq.q.empresas-particulares: Do you analyse for companies or only for individuals?
faq.a.empresas-particulares: Both. We work for individuals about to buy, invest or relocate as well as for companies and investors who need to understand the environment before a transaction. See both approaches in Sectors.
faq.a.cuanto-cuesta: Three clear levels: Essential, Superior and Premium, from €290. If you start with one level and later wish to extend it, for 60 days we deduct in full what you have already paid: you settle only the difference. See pricing and levels.
faq.q.hablar-antes: Can I speak to someone before deciding?
faq.a.hablar-antes: Yes. Write to us with your case and we reply within 24-48 hours (working days), with no commitment. If your situation is out of the ordinary, we look into it just the same.

mu.cap.title: Safety and community
mu.cap.sintesis: Summary: the area shows a stable community context according to official records for the last three years, with the seasonality typical of the coast.
mu.cap.src: [1] Ministry of the Interior — Crime statistics · [4] Town hall, annual report · [6] Two local outlets, cross-checked. Figures hidden because this is a sample; in your report they appear in full with a link to the source.
mu.cap.fy: With two children and your priority of peace, what matters in these figures is how the area behaves off-season: the records describe a stable environment in winter, with the usual summer peaks of floating population. The data describes; the final judgement is yours.
mu.mid.cta: I want this for my area
mu.pat.sec: 02 · What you only see by cross-referencing dimensions
mu.pat.title: Three patterns a single figure will not show
mu.pat.1: The area works all year round, not only in summer. The census, commercial activity and service hours all describe a stable population off-season.
mu.pat.2: Real travel times to healthcare depend on the eastern access. The map distance is short, but the main access concentrates seasonal traffic; the report details times by time slot.
mu.pat.3: Two planned public works will change daily life. Set out in official planning, they affect one access road and one school facility. They are described without speculating on their effect on prices.
mu.pat.callout: Why it matters. Anyone can look up a figure. The value lies in cross-referencing them: the patterns tell you how the area really works — what you cannot see in a one-afternoon visit.
mu.fu.title: Where what we tell you comes from
mu.fu.1d: Ministry of the Interior, INE, Cadastre, municipal planning, healthcare and education registers
mu.fu.2d: Local press, minutes and municipal announcements — only what is verified in more than one source
mu.fu.3d: Every figure cited to its source and cross-checked; what cannot be verified is discarded
mu.fu.vig: Validity note. This report is built with data current at the time of the order and reflects the situation at its issue date. We do not reuse old studies.
mu.fu.indep: Declaration of independence. This report has not been commissioned or funded by agencies, developers or property owners in the area. ROMVILL receives no commission linked to the client's decision.
mu.ent.pdf.d: The final document, protected against editing and with the file reference on every page. What we deliver stays as is, signed by ROMVILL: no one can alter it.
mu.ent.web.d: The private online version: easy to read on any device, with visual indicators. Access only via your personal link — no one else can see it.
mu.ent.note: Both formats contain the same report and are agreed when placing the order, depending on the chosen level. No editable files: what ROMVILL signs cannot be modified.

zona.marbella.intro.title: Marbella is not a single area
zona.marbella.intro.p1: Between the Golden Mile, Nueva Andalucía, San Pedro de Alcántara, the old town or the hillside urbanisations there are huge differences in safety, atmosphere, services and future. Two streets can be two worlds.
zona.marbella.intro.p2: Making a decision of this magnitude based on a single visit —or on what the seller tells you— is a gamble. ROMVILL studies the exact area you care about with an intelligence approach, not an estate-agent one.

modal.alicante.h3: A coast that keeps on growing
modal.alicante.p1: Alicante and its municipalities are experiencing a moment of strong property demand, and that is transforming many of its areas. Some areas are consolidating as highly sought-after environments, while others are growing so fast that it is worth knowing well how each place stands before deciding.
modal.alicante.p2: That is why we go beyond property portals: we study on the ground what each area is really like, its atmosphere, its surroundings and its daily life, to give you a clear and honest picture before you take the step.
modal.alicante.cov: Coverage area: Alicante city, El Campello, San Juan, San Vicente del Raspeig and bordering municipalities.
modal.malaga.p1: Málaga has become one of Europe's major innovation hubs. That boom has driven up interest in the city and made many neighbourhoods change rapidly, both in prices and in atmosphere and services.
modal.malaga.p2: That is why we study on the ground how each area of the metropolitan region stands today: its surroundings, its services, its evolution and its daily life, so you have a clear and reliable picture before making any decision.
modal.malaga.cov: Coverage area: Málaga capital, Torremolinos, Benalmádena, Fuengirola and the A-7 corridor.
modal.marbella.p1: Marbella and its high-value surroundings (Benahavís, Sierra Blanca) concentrate much of the most exclusive investment in Spain. It is a very particular market, where the real quality of each development is not always easy to know from the outside.
modal.marbella.p2: That is why we study each community on the ground: its occupancy level throughout the year, the condition and upkeep of the developments and the general atmosphere of the surroundings, so you truly know the area before investing or settling.
modal.marbella.cov: Coverage area: Marbella, Benahavís, Estepona, San Pedro Alcántara and Sierra Blanca.

ana.title:
What we analyse
so you decide with confidence
ana.desc: Before moving or taking any important step, Romvill thoroughly studies the area that interests you: real security, who lives there, what services it has and what it is like to get around that area.
ana.d1.title: Security of the Area
ana.d1.desc: We do not rely on rumours or appearances. We analyse the security of the area by combining verified information with direct verification of the atmosphere on the ground.
ana.d2.title: Demographic Profile
ana.d2.desc: Knowing the human environment of the area is essential. We draw up a precise profile of what the community that inhabits it is like.
ana.d3.title: Healthcare Coverage
ana.d3.desc: Health and emergencies cannot depend on chance. We map the availability and quality of nearby medical services.
ana.d3.i2: Distances to medical centres and accessibility
ana.d4.title: Connectivity and Mobility
ana.d4.desc: Your time matters. We study the area's arteries: road access, real peak-hour traffic and public transport options.
ana.cta.title: A report made for you
ana.cta.desc: We don't hand you scattered data or generic reports. We bring everything above —safety, neighbourhood, services and mobility— together into a single clear report, tailored to you, so you truly understand what the area is like before taking the step.
perfil.seg.intro: The security of an area is not measured by its appearance. We study it by combining verified information with direct observation on the ground.
perfil.seg.c1.title: Security of the environment
perfil.seg.c1.desc: We study the security context of each neighbourhood or development based on verified information and on-the-ground work.
perfil.seg.c2.title: Atmosphere and coexistence
perfil.seg.c2.desc: We gather how those who already live in the area perceive their environment: the everyday atmosphere, coexistence and the calm of daily life.
perfil.seg.c3.title: Surroundings and local services
perfil.seg.c3.desc: We observe elements of the surroundings that affect peace of mind: lighting, street maintenance and nearby services.
perfil.seg.c4.title: Aspects to bear in mind
perfil.seg.c4.desc: We point out aspects of the nearby environment worth knowing that may affect your peace of mind and your decision.
perfil.dem.intro: We show you what the community of the area is like: families, professionals, retirees and seasonal population. The human character of the environment where you are going to live.
perfil.dem.c1.title: Composition of the community
perfil.dem.c1.desc: The average age of the area, the presence of families and the proportion between year-round residents and the seasonal population.
perfil.dem.c2.title: Economic profile of the area
perfil.dem.c2.desc: The general income level of the area and the type of economic activity that predominates, so you understand the profile of the environment and its evolution.
perfil.dem.c3.title: Evolution of the area
perfil.dem.c3.desc: How the environment has evolved in recent years: whether the population grows or shrinks, whether it is renewed with new people or tends to age, and where that trend is heading.
perfil.dem.c4.title: International community
perfil.dem.c4.desc: The presence of foreign residents in the area, the most established nationalities and the communities already settled, useful if you are looking for an environment with people of your own origin or language.
perfil.san.intro: We analyse the healthcare infrastructure accessible from the area: hospitals, health centres, pharmacies and emergency access times.
perfil.san.c1.title: Hospital network
perfil.san.c1.desc: Distance and access time to the nearest hospitals (public and private), available specialities and level of saturation.
perfil.san.c2.title: Primary care
perfil.san.c2.desc: Assigned health centres, appointment availability, doctor-to-patient ratio and how the professionals are rated.
perfil.san.c3.title: Pharmacies and emergencies
perfil.san.c3.desc: On-duty pharmacies, nearby 24-hour emergency services and estimated emergency response times.
perfil.san.c4.title: Specialised services
perfil.san.c4.desc: Geriatric centres, rehabilitation, specialised paediatrics and other medical services relevant to the resident's profile.
perfil.mov.intro: We study how the area moves: road access, public transport, parking and real travel times.
perfil.mov.c1.title: Road access
perfil.mov.c1.desc: Motorways, dual carriageways and main roads connected to the area. Access times to the airport and nearby cities.
perfil.mov.c2.title: Public transport
perfil.mov.c2.desc: Nearby bus stops, train, metro or tram stations, service frequencies, quality of service, etc.
perfil.mov.c3.title: Parking
perfil.mov.c3.desc: Availability of public and private parking, average cost, ease of finding a spot and parking options in the surroundings, among other aspects.
perfil.mov.c4.title: Travel times
perfil.mov.c4.desc: We measure how long it takes to reach the key points of the area: work, schools, hospitals, beach, etc.
perfil.pro.intro: We analyse where the area is heading: planned works, public investment and approved urban plans that will change its surroundings — documented facts, with no price speculation.
perfil.pro.c1.title: Market evolution
perfil.pro.c1.desc: Historical price evolution and the current market trend, described with official data — no forecasts, no promises of appreciation.
perfil.pro.c2.title: Urban development projects
perfil.pro.c2.desc: Planned works, new infrastructure, changes to the municipal master plan (PGOU) and developments that will affect the area in the medium term.
perfil.pro.c3.title: Public investment
perfil.pro.c3.desc: Municipal budgets allocated to the area, planned improvements to public services and urban regeneration plans.
perfil.pro.c4.title: Signs of transformation
perfil.pro.c4.desc: Observable changes in the area: new businesses, the evolving resident profile and the transformation of the commercial fabric — described, never framed as advice.

priv.title: Privacy Policy
priv.intro: At Romvill we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy describes what information we collect, how we use it and what your rights are under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
priv.s1.title: Data we collect
priv.s1.body: When you use our contact form we collect: first name, last name, email address, phone (optional), area of interest and the message you send us. We do not collect payment data or install third-party tracking cookies.
priv.s2.title: How we use your data
priv.s2.body: We use your data exclusively to respond to your report request and manage the commercial relationship should you choose to proceed. We do not sell or share your data with third parties. Your data is processed on the basis of your consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR) or for the performance of a contract (Art. 6.1.b GDPR). Data is retained for the time strictly necessary to manage the requested service.
priv.s3.title: Your rights
priv.s3.body: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, data portability and to object to the processing of your data. To exercise any of these rights, write to us at info@romvill.com with the subject "GDPR Rights". You may also lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority.
priv.sval.title: Client assessments and testimonials
priv.sval.body: Through the assessment form available at romvill.com/feedback we process the following data: the dossier reference, the score awarded and any comments the client chooses to provide. The purpose is service improvement and quality control of the dossiers issued. The legal basis is performance of the engagement (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) —completion of the form constitutes the agreed consideration for dossiers issued at no cost— and, additionally, our legitimate interest in assessing and improving the quality of the service (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). These assessments are private by default and are not published. An assessment is published as a testimonial only where the client has given express, unambiguous consent by means of a checkbox that is never pre-ticked (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), and following human review. In published testimonials the client is identified solely by first name, the initial of the surname and the area analysed; the email address, telephone number and full dossier reference are not published. Consent may be withdrawn at any time and without justification: it is sufficient to write to info@romvill.com requesting removal of the testimonial, which will be withdrawn without undue delay; withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out beforehand. Assessments are retained for a maximum of five years from receipt, after which they are erased or irreversibly anonymised for statistical purposes; published testimonials are retained for as long as consent remains in force and are removed upon withdrawal.
priv.s4.title: Data controller
priv.s4.body: Controller: Romvill. Contact email: info@romvill.com. Registered address: Spain. If you have any questions about the processing of your data, please do not hesitate to contact us.
terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: By accessing or using the Romvill website and requesting our services, you accept these terms and conditions. If you do not agree with any of them, please do not use the service.
terms.s1.title: Service description
terms.s1.body: Romvill provides territorial analysis and intelligence services on the Spanish Mediterranean Coast. The reports are informational documents and do not constitute binding legal, financial or real estate advice. Each report is prepared on a personalised basis under the professional criteria of the Romvill team and delivered within the timeframe agreed with the client.
terms.s2.title: Limitation of liability
terms.s2.body: Romvill does not guarantee that the data included in the report is exhaustive or fully up-to-date at the time of delivery. The information should not be used as the sole criterion for purchase, investment or relocation decisions. Romvill is not responsible for decisions made based on the reports nor for any resulting damages.
terms.s3.title: Intellectual property
terms.s3.body: All reports, methodologies and website content are the intellectual property of Romvill. Their total or partial reproduction without written authorisation is prohibited. The client may use the report for personal or internal business use, but not for commercial redistribution or publication without consent.
terms.s4.title: Governing law
terms.s4.body: These terms are governed by Spanish law. Any dispute arising will be submitted to the courts of the city of Alicante, unless applicable consumer protection regulations provide for a different jurisdiction.
legal.aviso.title: Legal Notice
legal.aviso.s1.title: Service Provider Identification
legal.aviso.s1.intro: In accordance with the transparency and information duties applicable to online services (Directive 2000/31/EC on electronic commerce and its national transpositions), the following identifying details are provided:

legal.aviso.s2.title: Purpose and Activity
legal.aviso.s2.p1: ROMVILL is a territorial intelligence consultancy. Its activity consists of producing independent area-analysis reports —safety, services, surroundings, mobility, market and regulatory framework— to inform property purchase or investment decisions on the Spanish Mediterranean coast.
legal.aviso.s2.p2: ROMVILL maintains a position of neutrality towards the real-estate sector: it does not broker sales, does not market properties and receives no commissions from agencies, developers, banks or any party with an interest in the transaction. Its only consideration is the report the client commissions. This is the basis of its impartiality.
legal.aviso.s2.p3: In preparing each report, ROMVILL draws on official sources, public records and its own research resources. During the data-gathering and structuring phase, artificial-intelligence tools are used; in line with the transparency duty set out in European regulations, it is expressly stated that judgement, verification and final validation always rest with a professional human analyst, who cross-checks, interprets and signs off every study. That human judgement prevails over any automated process and constitutes the essential value of ROMVILL's work.
legal.aviso.s2.p4: Each report is prepared on a bespoke basis for the client: it is tailored to their profile, to the area of interest and to their priorities —home or investment—. It is not an off-the-shelf product but a singular analysis for each commission. The reports are advisory and decision-support in nature: they neither guarantee the decision nor replace the legal, tax or financial advice that each transaction may require.
legal.aviso.s3.title: Intellectual and Industrial Property
legal.aviso.s3.body: All the contents of this site —brand, logo, texts, reports, designs and graphic elements— are owned by ROMVILL or used under due authorisation, and are protected by Spanish and international intellectual and industrial property law. Their reproduction, distribution or transformation without express authorisation is prohibited.
legal.aviso.s4.title: Terms of Use and Liability
legal.aviso.s4.body: ROMVILL's reports are prepared from official and public sources and constitute an advisory, decision-support analysis. They do not replace professional legal, tax or real-estate advice. ROMVILL is not liable for the decisions taken by the user on the basis of the information provided, nor for any changes that official sources may undergo after the date of each report.

legal.aviso.s5.body: The processing of users' personal data is governed by the %s, in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD).
legal.aviso.s6.title: Applicable Law and Jurisdiction
legal.aviso.s6.body: These terms are governed by Spanish law. For the resolution of any dispute, the parties submit to the courts and tribunals that are competent under the applicable consumer protection rules.

muestra.fict: Sample document. This dossier was produced in a full trial run for a fictitious client. The data on the area — Elviria, East Marbella — is real and verified; the client's personal details are invented. What follows is a condensed selection of its sections.
muestra.cov.scope: A dossier built to the client's brief: each section answers a specific priority, and every figure is cited to its source.
muestra.s1.mini: The reference hospital, 24-hour A&E and local clinics — with journey times verified
muestra.s1.lede: We have verified it on the ground: the main public hospital sits on the same motorway that borders Elviria, 8 minutes away.
muestra.s1.c1d: The area's main public hospital, with A&E open 24 hours, 365 days a year. The route is by direct motorway, without crossing the town centre.
muestra.s1.c2d: The municipality's leading private hospital, with some 75 specialities and the area's only permanent private paediatric emergency unit.
muestra.s1.c3d: A private general practice geared to foreign residents — the first medical address in the dossier that is, quite literally, a short walk from home.
muestra.s1.fy: With young children, what reassures is not that "there is a hospital nearby": it is knowing precisely which one, that its emergency unit never closes, and that you reach it by direct motorway — no traffic lights, no town centre. We have verified this on the ground.
muestra.s2.mini: Three years of official Interior Ministry statistics, charted
muestra.s2.lede: We have analysed three years of official statistics, and all three say the same: street crime remains stable, and household burglaries have fallen for three consecutive years.
muestra.s2.hito: Household burglaries: down for the third year running. It is the figure that matters most to anyone buying a home — and the one improving fastest.
muestra.s2.cu: Cases per year · Spanish Interior Ministry
muestra.s2.cr: Reading: three consecutive years of decline — from 629 cases in 2023 to around 410 in 2025. The official 2025 figure is published as a variation (−21%); we show it in round numbers.
muestra.s2.fy: The question you are really asking is: can my children play outside? Three years of official data answer it: physical crime is not deteriorating, and the figure that matters most to a homebuyer improves year after year.
muestra.s3.mini: Journey times verified by ROMVILL, by car and on foot
muestra.s3.lede: We have driven the route: Málaga airport is a long half-hour away by motorway, and daily life is resolved within the area itself.
muestra.s3.tren: We tell you this with the clarity it deserves: Marbella has no railway station — it is the largest city in Spain without a rail connection. Every train journey begins by car or bus: commuter rail at Fuengirola (22 min) or high-speed rail in Málaga (44 min). We have verified this in the official documentation.
muestra.s3.fy: Elviria runs on the car; the bus covers the odd day, and an early-morning flight is handled with a taxi booked the night before. For a family with one foot abroad, the half-hour to the airport is one of the things you come to value most over the years.
muestra.s4.mini: The complete official series from the state meteorological agency, charted
muestra.s4.lede: Elviria lives between pine forest and sea, with one of the mildest winters in continental Europe — and it does not shut down off-season: its permanent residents keep shops and services open all twelve months.
muestra.s4.cr: Reading: no month falls below a 12 °C mean; winter is lived at highs of 17 °C, and summer is tempered by the sea breeze.
muestra.s4.invd: Sunny and mild: a light coat at night, a terrace at midday. Most of the year's ~42 rainy days fall between November and March.
muestra.s4.prid: Terraces from March; the countryside at its best. The sea, at 16–17°, still cold for swimming.
muestra.s4.verd: Practically no rain in July and August; sea at 22–24°, heat tempered by the sea breeze.
muestra.s4.otod: The "second spring": the sea is warmer than in June, and swimming carries on into October.
muestra.s4.sol: 2,905 hours of sunshine a year — over 1,000 hours more than Munich (~1,830 h according to the German meteorological service). The trial dossier was produced for a fictitious German client: every report compares the climate with the client's home country.
muestra.s4.fy: Winter was the client's decisive test — and it is passed: the area does not shut down off-season, because most of its residents live here all year round. School, supermarket, pharmacy and everyday restaurants remain open in January.
muestra.s5.mini: An honest reading: each risk with its level and its check
muestra.s5.intro: No area is free of risk. What distinguishes a good decision is knowing the risks through data — and knowing which check belongs to each one.
muestra.s5.th3: What it means in plain terms
muestra.s5.r1d: Elviria lives among pine forest: there was a major fire in 2012, and precisely for that reason it is now one of the municipality's most actively protected areas.
muestra.s5.r2d: The risk is not area-wide: it concentrates along the two streams and the underpasses beneath the motorway. Hillside villas sit above the usual reach.
muestra.s5.r3d: The year's rain falls concentrated in a few intense episodes between September and December — the normal pattern across the entire Mediterranean coast.
muestra.s5.r4d: Low-to-moderate seismicity: occasional tremors that are felt without causing damage. Since 2002, every new home is engineered to seismic standards.
muestra.s5.r5d: Crime stable across the municipality and household burglaries down three years running; a consolidated residential area with monitored communities.
muestra.s5.r6d: The motorway is East Marbella's only artery: rush-hour hold-ups and summer peaks. It is the most constant practical cost of living in the area.
muestra.s5.esc: Descriptive scale — Low: documented as of little significance in the area · Moderate: a real phenomenon, bounded in time or space, with known management · Attention: warrants an active check on your part.
muestra.cta.t: Your area, with this same rigour
muestra.cta.p: What you have just explored is a condensed sample of a real dossier. Yours is built from scratch on the exact area you care about, focused on your priorities and with every figure in full. Begin with the questionnaire: five minutes.

ui.field.p: Desk research organises the data; the field confirms it. We walk the area at different times of day, check on site what official sources describe, and cross-reference every observation before it enters the file. What cannot be verified does not go into the report.
ui.field.s3d: Every observation verified before it enters
ui.dims.title: Five readings of the same area
ui.dims.lead: No decision about a place rests on a single data point. Each dimension answers a different question, and the five together draw the full map: who lives there, what life is like, what services exist, how you get around, and where it is heading.
ui.final.p: Choose the area, tell us what concerns you and receive the full file. No commitment until you confirm the order.
ui.sup.p: The base report already covers all five dimensions. These add-ons are for specific cases: a second area to compare against, an extra dimension from the catalogue, or the analysis of one particular property.
ui.cmp.lead: On the left, what anyone can see on a visit or in a listing. On the right, what actually needs checking before deciding. The gap between the two columns is exactly what a ROMVILL report contains.
ui.expo.nota: This is a reduced sample. The real report develops each dimension with its data, its sources and the analyst’s conclusions.
